title: 표지판 읽기: 화장실은 어디예요? 출구는요?
objective: By the end, you can read signs for restrooms, exits, and emergency exits, and follow the arrows to find the place you need.
summary: Learners read common Korean signs for restrooms, exits, and emergency exits in stations and buildings.
note: All signs on this worksheet are examples made for practice.

task.title: Read the signs
task.line: Look at each sign or situation, then choose, fill in, or answer as the instruction says.

items.text: This sign shows where the toilets are.
This is the restroom for men. Signs often show only 남.
This is the restroom for women. Signs often show only 여.
This is the door or way out. In stations, exits have numbers.
This is the door you use to go in.
Stations use this sign to show the way to the exits.
Use this door in a fire or an emergency.
This sign shows where the stairs are.
This sign shows where the elevator is.
You see this on a restroom door when someone is inside.

sections.heading: Read a real-style sign
paragraphs: 나가는 곳 Exit　← 1·2번 출구　|　3·4번 출구 →　|　화장실 ↑　|　엘리베이터 ←
← means 왼쪽 (left). → means 오른쪽 (right). ↑ means go straight. On this sign, exits 1 and 2 are on the left, the restroom is straight ahead, and the elevator is on the left.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: Signs often use short forms: 남 = 남자 and 여 = 여자. Look for the arrow next to each word before you start walking.
In Korea, the 비상구 sign is green and shows a running person. Many signs also have English words, but read the Korean first. It is usually bigger.

exercises: Choose the right sign: ① There is a fire in the building. (비상구 / 입구) ② You want to wash your hands. (화장실 / 계단) ③ You want to go into the shop. (입구 / 출구)
Look at the sign and answer in English: 화장실 → | 엘리베이터 ← | 3번 출구 ↑ — Which way is the elevator?
Yes or No: ① The restroom door says 사용 중. You can go in now. ② The 나가는 곳 sign shows the way out. ③ You use the 비상구 in an emergency.
Fill in the blank: 엘리베이터가 없어요. ____으로 올라가요.
Look at the sign (남 ← | → 여) and answer in Korean: 여자 화장실은 어느 쪽에 있어요?
answers: ① 비상구 ② 화장실 ③ 입구
① No ② Yes ③ Yes
